description: Na₂CBiAsO₇ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/m space group. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.79 Å. C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There is one shorter (1.25 Å) and two longer (1.32 Å) C-O bond lengths. Bi is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Bi-O bond distances ranging from 2.27-2.71 Å. As is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of As-O bond distances ranging from 1.68-1.73 Å. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two equivalent Na and one C atom. In the second O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, one C, and one Bi atom to form distorted corner-sharing ONa₂BiC trigonal pyramids. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one C, and one Bi atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Bi, and one As atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Bi, and one As atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, one Bi, and one As atom to form distorted corner-sharing ONa₂BiAs tetrahedra.
